title: Shortest Distance to a Character
description: Given a lowercase string `s` and a single-character string `c` that is guaranteed to occur at least once in `s`, return an integer array `answer` of length `s.length` where `answer[i]` is the shortest distance from index `i` to the closest occurrence of `c` in `s`.
constraints: s and c consist of lowercase English letters, and c occurs at least once in s.
hints: Run one pass from left to right tracking the most recent index of c.
Run a second pass from right to left taking the minimum distance to the nearest c on the right.

examples.explanation: The letter 'e' sits at indices 3, 5, 6, and 11, giving minimal distances at every index.
The letter 'b' is at index 3, so distances decrease from 3 down to 0.
Every position is already 'a', so all distances are 0.
